verse.verse_2: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
verse.verse_3: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
verse.verse_4: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
verse.verse_5: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
verse.verse_6: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
verse.verse_7: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
verse.verse_8: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
verse.verse_9: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
verse.verse_11: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
verse.verse_12: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
verse.verse_13: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
verse.verse_14: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
verse.verse_15: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
verse.verse_16: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
verse.verse_17: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
verse.verse_18: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
verse.verse_19: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
verse.verse_20: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
verse.verse_21: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
verse.verse_22: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
verse.verse_23: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
verse.verse_24: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
verse.verse_25: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
verse.verse_26: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
verse.verse_27: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
verse.verse_28: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
verse.verse_29: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
verse.verse_30: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
verse.verse_31: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
verse.verse_32: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
verse.verse_33: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
verse.verse_34: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
verse.verse_35: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
verse.verse_36: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
verse.verse_37: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
verse.verse_38: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
verse.verse_39: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
verse.verse_40: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
verse.verse_41: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
verse.verse_42: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
verse.verse_43: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
verse.verse_44: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
verse.verse_45: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
verse.verse_46: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
verse.verse_47: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of pace.
verse.verse_48: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
verse.verse_49: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
verse.verse_50: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
verse.verse_51: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
verse.verse_52: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
verse.verse_53: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
verse.verse_54: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
verse.verse_55: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
verse.verse_56: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
verse.verse_57: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
verse.verse_58: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
verse.verse_59: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
verse.verse_60: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
